cases.title: Fix and run my script (four planted bugs)

steps.say:
Fix and run my script, then show me the image.

```python
import numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
w, h = 480, 360
x = np.linspace(-1.6, 1.6, w)
y = np.linspace(-1.2, 1.2, h)
X, Y = np.meshgrid(x, y)
z = (X + 1j*Y).astype(np.complex)
c = -0.4 + 0.6j
count = np.zeros((w, h), dtype=np.int)
for i in range(120):
    mask = np.abs(z) < 2
    z[mask] = z[mask]**2 + c
    count[mask] += 1
plt.imshow(count, cmap="magma", extent=[-1.6, 1.6, -1.2, 1.2])
plt.axis("off")
plt.show()
```

End your reply with one line of exactly this form: DEFECTS: <comma-separated list> , naming every visual defect present in the image you delivered, using only these words: blank, clipping, banding, pixelation, low_contrast, none.

criteria.text: The delivered image is a Julia set (what the script was trying to draw).
The reply names at least two of the script's real bugs: the removed np.complex alias, the removed np.int alias, the swapped (w, h) shape, plt.show() instead of saving a file.
